source.starting_point: Pillar-0 RSNA fine-tune and official pillar-finetune Sybil configuration
source.provenance_note: This is an engineering default for the present imbalanced five-class task. A real 384-cube backward smoke completed on the local RTX 4090 only through Windows shared GPU memory; a 48 GB accelerator is recommended. It is intentionally distinct from publication_full_finetune.json.

task_adaptations.head: LayerNorm(1152) + Dropout(0.1) + Linear(1152, 5)
task_adaptations.memory_strategy: batch size 1 with FP32 master weights and BF16 autocast when supported; the released wrapper does not support encoder gradient checkpointing
task_adaptations.selection_policy: development folds only; held-out test evaluated after configuration selection
